_meta.indication: For the treatment of adults with metastatic basal cell carcinoma, or with locally advanced basal cell carcinoma that has recurred following surgery or who are not candidates for surgery, and who are not candidates for radiation.

pivotal_trials.design: A single, international, single-arm, multi-center, open-label, 2-cohort trial.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with metastatic basal cell carcinoma (mBCC) or locally advanced BCC (laBCC); laBCC lesions required to have recurred after radiotherapy unless radiotherapy was contraindicated or inappropriate.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Objective response rate (ORR) as assessed by an independent review facility (IRF).
pivotal_trials.n: 104 patients enrolled (mBCC n=33; laBCC n=71); 96 evaluable for ORR.
pivotal_trials.result: Among the 96 efficacy-evaluable patients, IRF-confirmed ORR was 30.3% (95% CI 15.6, 48.2) in mBCC (n=33) and 42.9% (95% CI 30.5, 56.0) in laBCC (n=63 efficacy-evaluable). Median duration of response was 7.6 months (95% CI 5.62, not estimable) in the mBCC cohort and 7.6 months (95% CI 5.65, 9.66) in the laBCC cohort.

key_safety: Safety evaluated in 138 patients; most common adverse reactions were muscle spasms (72%), alopecia (64%), dysgeusia (55%), weight loss (45%), fatigue (40%), nausea (30%), diarrhea (29%), decreased appetite (25%), constipation (21%), arthralgias (16%), vomiting (14%), and ageusia (11%).
target_moa: Vismodegib is an inhibitor of the Hedgehog signaling pathway; it binds to and inhibits Smoothened, a transmembrane protein involved in Hedgehog signal transduction.

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: EMBRYO-FETAL DEATH AND SEVERE BIRTH DEFECTS — ERIVEDGE can result in embryo-fetal death or severe birth defects; it is embryotoxic and teratogenic in animals.

rems.type: A REMS was determined not to be required to ensure safe use of ERIVEDGE.

advisory_committee.vote: ERIVEDGE was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

description.text: Modified dosing regimen to allow treatment interruptions of up to 8 weeks for intolerable adverse reactions and added precocious puberty information to Pediatric Use section

citations.quote: This supplemental new drug application provides for modifications to the existing dosing regimen to allow for treatment interruptions of up to 8 weeks for intolerable adverse reactions. Additional updates include the addition of information about precocious puberty to the Pediatric Use section of the product insert.

orphan_indication.text: Orphan Drug Designation was requested for vismodegib in Gorlin syndrome but FDA did not grant it because the mechanism of action is not specific to BCC and BCC is not a rare disease.

citations.quote: syndrome but since the mechanism of action of vismodegib is not specific to BCC and BCC is not a rare disease or condition, FDA did not grant Orphan Drug Designation.

summary.text: ERIVEDGE received regular (full) approval under Priority review for advanced basal cell carcinoma based on durable objective response rates in a single-arm trial; it was not an accelerated approval and was not referred to an advisory committee.
